name: Hybrid Blocky-Smooth Voxel Meshing
aliases: Binary smooth voxels with sharp features
definition: A technique to generate a mesh from binary voxel data that preserves sharp, blocky features (90-degree angles) in some regions while smoothing others, using separate mesh passes for different material types.
summary: Hybrid Blocky-Smooth Voxel Meshing generates triangular meshes from binary voxel data by using separate passes to preserve sharp blocky features while smoothing other regions, avoiding complex case tables.
